errors.description: A worked buttonhole with no button appears low on the centre front, at the position where the drawing carries only a small annotation arrow.
errors.expected: Nothing at that position, or a button seated in its buttonhole.
errors.correction: Omit the low buttonhole, or seat a button in it.

notes: Blueprint (vest-bottom-straight.jpg) is a cropped waistcoat lower front. Magnified inspection of its hem confirms a single straight edge running level across the whole bottom with no V and no points at the centre front — the absence of points is the whole option, and the candidate reproduces it exactly. Pocket welt angle, dart count and button count all match the drawing.
